label: early copy steps with a 3 coming up in the output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It never fires in the original phase or at the delimiter step, and never on the first-occurrence input. Most mass falls at recall_idx 1-4. The strongest driver is an upcoming digit 3 in the output stream: rates reach 47% when the current output is 3 (12x lift) and 48% when the next output is 3. Top activations (~6.7) come right after <DEL> when the original starts x 3 3 3, and activation decays over successive steps as the 3s are emitted. Output 2 and more digits in the sequence give weaker boosts. There is also a broad low-magnitude tail (bottom quartiles, under ~0.5) on early copy steps with no 3 nearby, which the predicate misses. Late copy steps (recall_idx >= 5) are rarely active. Dev P 0.67 / R 0.54 / mass recall 0.78.
